mg_slots.reason: speaker reads phone/notes (head/eyes down, face-landmark eyeLookDown + pitch, verified on contact sheets)
mg_slots.spoken: Ozg'in, vazn ololmay yurganlarga vazn olish uchun ko'p yeyish kerak, ko'p yeyish esa qiyin. Shu vaqtda sizga yordamga suyuq ovqat, ya'ni geyner kerak bo'ladi.
mg_slots.title: Vazn olish uchun
mg_slots.subtitle: ko'p yeyish kerak

cards.title: Vazn olish uchun
cards.subtitle: ko'p yeyish kerak
cards.visual: Thin silhouette outline + a flat weight graph line; plate icon slides in on 'ko'p yeyish'.

cards.title: Ko'p yeyish — qiyin
cards.visual: Three stacked plate cards, the top one tilts away; soft clock ring ticks once.

cards.title: Yechim: GEYNER
cards.subtitle: suyuq ovqat
cards.visual: 3D shaker bottle rotates in, liquid swirl in cobalt glow; label chip 'GEYNER' lands on 'geyner'.

mg_slots.enter: glide up 40 px + blur 12->0 + opacity 0->1, 0.35 s, ease cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), lands on beat
mg_slots.exit: scale 1.0->1.04 + blur 0->10 + fade, 0.25 s, ease cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), lands on beat

mg_slots.reason: speaker reads phone/notes (head/eyes down, face-landmark eyeLookDown + pitch, verified on contact sheets)
mg_slots.spoken: Kreatin ATF zaxirasini ko'paytiradi. Bu muskullardagi asosiy energiya manbai bo'ladi. Kreatin oddiy go'shtda bor.
mg_slots.title: ATF zaxirasi ↑

cards.title: ATF zaxirasi ↑
cards.visual: Battery/energy cells filling bottom-up in icy blue, label 'ATF'.

cards.title: Muskul energiyasi
cards.subtitle: asosiy manba
cards.visual: Stylised muscle fibre with a pulse of light travelling along it.

cards.title: Go'shtda ham bor
cards.visual: Glass card with a steak icon; sets up the next to-camera line '5 g = 1,5 kg go'sht'.
